name: Jizhong Energy Resources Co., Ltd.
summary: Jizhong Energy Resources Co., Ltd. engages in the coal business in China and internationally. The company operates through Coal Business, Electricity Business, Building Business, Chemical Business, and Other Operations segments. The company offers coal products; electricity; cement, fiberglass, and related products; and coke, PVC, and related products. It also engages in raw coal mining; coal coking; chemical; tourist hotel; and non-metallic material activities. The company exports its products. The company was formerly known as Hebei Jinniu Energy & Resources Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Jizhong Energy Resources Co., Ltd. in January 2010.
